summary: 2010년 4월 소청도에서 처음 기록된 길잃은새로, 국내 기록은 지금까지 10건이 안 된다. 중국 북부·서부와 몽골, 바이칼호 남부, 티베트 동남부에 걸친 산지의 바위 비탈과 덤불에 살며, 북쪽 무리는 겨울에 낮은 곳이나 남쪽으로 옮겨 간다. 겨울에는 주로 풀씨를 먹는다.

art.subject: Godlewski's Bunting (Emberiza godlewskii), adult male, a vagrant on a rocky hillside in Korea in early spring: head, throat and breast pale blue-grey; a chestnut stripe along each side of the crown and a chestnut stripe behind the eye; a short blackish line on the lores in front of the eye; a dark moustachial stripe, blackish from the base of the bill, outlining the grey ear coverts; mantle rufous-brown with bold blackish streaks; rump unstreaked chestnut; wings with black-centred, rufous-fringed coverts and tertials; belly and flanks warm cinnamon-rufous; tail dark with white outer feathers. Bill conical, upper mandible black, lower mandible grey; eye dark; legs pinkish.
art.pose: hopping on a rock among dry grass, side view
art.scene: dry rocky hillside with sparse grass and bare shrubs in Korea in early spring (March), clear light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view hopping on a rock: grey head, throat and breast, chestnut lateral crown stripes and chestnut stripe behind the eye, black lores and moustachial stripe, rufous-brown back streaked black, unstreaked rufous rump, buffy-orange belly and flanks, long tail with white outer feathers, pinkish legs

adult male, head detail in side view: grey crown centre bordered by chestnut lateral crown stripes, chestnut stripe behind the eye, black lores, black moustachial stripe below the grey ear-coverts, grey throat, conical bill with a black upper and grey lower mandible
art.build: A medium-sized, long-tailed bunting, a little larger than a sparrow, slim with a rounded head; no crest, the crown feathers lie flat. Hops on rocks and bare ground. Bill small and conical, shorter than the head, black above and grey below. Legs pinkish, medium length. The long, notched tail extends well beyond the wingtips and has white outer feathers.
avoid: Do not paint black crown stripes or a black eye-stripe — that is Rock Bunting (Emberiza cia); Godlewski's crown and eye-stripes are chestnut, only the lores and the front of the moustache are blackish.
Do not paint a white face and white throat with dark stripes — that is Meadow Bunting, common in Korea; Godlewski's face and throat are grey.
Do not paint a streaked rump; it is plain chestnut.
